messages:
sarah-m: quick sync — following the RFC, i sketched the minimal delta surface we need between hosted/dedicated/private. want to align on auth, observability, and fallback semantics 

mike-l: SGTM. can you paste the sketch here? short bullets are fine.

sarah-m: sure — top-level ideas: 1) auth: hosted uses token + account mapping; private must accept customer KMS-backed tokens and a paired auth proxy. 2) observability: traces must carry tenant id but not exfil secrets; private can forward sampled traces to customer OTEL endpoint. 3) fallbacks: runtime should be able to route to lower-capacity variant without changing API surface.

raj-p: i have concerns about (1) token translation complexity and (2) rollout behavior when a private deployment is temporarily unreachable.

linh: +1 on raj. for token translation we need a small adapter contract: translate(input-token) -> canonical-tenant-id | error. keep it sync/fast.

mike-l: for rollouts — propose a two-phase fallback: phase A route-level config that prefers private, but will failover to dedicated after Xms or Y errors; phase B a health-probe that flips routing at control-plane when sustained errors.

raj-p: sounds ok. how do we express X/Y in manifests? i want it declarative and versioned.

sarah-m: manifest field suggestion (proto-y):

```
hosting: 
  policy: 
    prefer: private
    failover: 
      latency_ms: 200
      error_threshold: 5
      sustained_window_secs: 30
```

sarah-m: manifest changes must be additive and backwards compatible. older agents should ignore unknown fields.

linh: observability edge case: private deployments might refuse sample export. we should include a fallback to redact-and-forward minimal telemetry to our control plane so we can surface basic SLO metrics to customers. privacy mode = "redact" in manifest.

mike-l: Agree. Also, quantization/compute hints should be runtime-only metadata — do not force customers to know them. separate "serve-hints" section that the control plane can use, but agent ignores.

raj-p: ops question — secret rotation when control plane rebinds a private. if we do token-translation adapter, it must support key rollover. plan: adapter watches KMS keys and supports staged key IDs in the manifest.

linh: test plan: e2e matrix with combinations: hosted->private failover, private->dedicated cold start, manifest with unknown fields, sample export denied. We should automate via the local shim harness.

mike-l: ok. next steps: sarah can PR the manifest schema change + adapter contract doc. raj to draft rotation flow. linh to own test harness scenarios. i'll sketch the routing state machine and probe thresholds.

deploy-bot: deploy check: no CI changes required for this thread.

sarah-m: thanks all — i'll drop draft into the RFC follow-up doc and ping for comments. :thumbsup:
